title: Genesis: harden all agent-facing command surfaces
body: Interactive agents should not have to infer DontPanic workflow from generic flag docs. The platform already has agent brief, what-now/next JSON, command validation, ActionItem, and onboarding files, but root help and workflow command help do not consistently teach the safe policy. This plan makes command discovery Harbor-like: start here for AI agents, inspect JSON, run read-only surfaces first, and only mutate/dispatch from automatable ActionItems or explicit human approval.

title: Inventory is a projection, not a second command registry
body: The command guidance inventory must be generated from or validated against existing sources of truth: command_validation.known_subcommands, agent_manifest, cli.py dispatch surfaces, and ActionItem exact_command semantics. It must not become another hand-maintained list that drifts from the real CLI.

title: Agent help augments but does not replace the generated brief
body: The generated agent brief remains the canonical full operating model. This plan adds short command-local agent guidance and a JSON command-guidance surface so agents that land on a specific command still find the safe workflow. Long explanations stay in the brief/guide; command help stays concise.

title: No autonomous run-loop or scheduler in this plan
body: This plan prepares agents to use existing tools correctly. It deliberately excludes autonomous cross-feature run, fleet scheduling, parallelism, and same-plan isolation. Those need policy_allowed/budget reservation/durable supervisor work and belong downstream of the control-plane spine.
